assertion.text: Erdős Problem #1033: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Let $h(n)$ be such that every graph on $n$ vertices with $>n^2/4$ many edges contains a triangle whose vertices have degrees summing to at least $h(n)$. Estimate $h(n)$. In particular, is it true that\[h(n)\geq (2(\sqrt{3}-1)-o(1))n?\] Current best: The lower bound was improved to $\frac{21}{16}n$ by Fan \cite{Fa88}. Prize: no. Tags: graph theory.
